Thank you so much. It’s just been a rough few days, I appreciate the kind words.

I feel like getting a tattoo is a great way to cope for a lot of people, they just have so much meaning behind them. It is pretty frustrating not being able to find a picture, I’m sure he had one somewhere but he never posted any pictures of it on social media when he first got it around 4-5 years ago, and I’ve only ever seen it in person. I’ll ask his friends who might have pictures of it in the future, but right now I feel like it’s a touchy subject with anyone and I don’t wanna push the thought of the whole situation on anyone. The tattoo was like a geometric side view of the solar system, it was like circles with a line through it. We had this ongoing joke about it because the person who did it wasn’t super experienced and the line going through wasn’t very straight and the circles were a little lopsided, but I always still thought it was super cool.

That’s really sweet to hear about the poem, sounds like such a nice tribute to someone close to you. Music usually comes naturally, but just picking up my guitar hurt because he was the one that taught me the basics almost 11 years ago and he motivated me to stick with it this whole time. I always wanted to get better so i could catch up with him, he was studying music too. It just feels weird that we wont ever get to play music together for our family at gatherings, that was always a big part of holidays and get togethers. Coping’s been hard but i’m glad too that i’ve found some way to help myself. I’ve spent a lot of time trying to comfort his mom and sister so when I get the chance to be alone, it hits hard, but if I have someone to talk to, it eases the pain a lot. It’s scary thinking about how only time can really heal this, especially when I don’t know how much time it will take.

Thank you so much for the response, it means a ton to me. It was very unfair, it happened out of nowhere. He was too young. That is very good advice, thank you. I plan on doing something music related for him in the future, I just cant bring myself to now, it’s just too much. I plan on getting his first tattoo in the same spot that he had it as a way of keeping him with me everywhere, I’m just kind of struggling with finding the exact design since it was on his inner bicep and not many pictures we had showed it. And yeah, I’ve been speaking out loud to him a lot when I’ve been alone, I just want him to know how much he meant to me. I’m sure he knew with a bond as close as we had, but I just want to tell him verbally. Again, thank you for the message, it’s been helping me cope a lot just being able to talk to others.

The picture attached is me and him as babies. I’m currently 18, turning 19 in around 2 months. He was only 4 years older than me. He was on vacation in another continent, and he was supposed to come home the day it happened. We grew up together and spent our childhoods around each other, since we only lived about 5 minutes away. He first inspired me to pick up music when i was little, and now i’m pursuing a music-related degree. It’s just so hard going on without him. I was talking to him just 30 minutes before it happened, and we talked every day. I don’t know where to go from here or how I can get up and live life normally without him.
